sloka: सरामम् अपि तावन् मे रथम् दृष्ट्वा तदा जनः ।विना रामम् रथम् दृष्ट्वा विदीर्येत अपि सा पुरी ॥२-५२-४०॥
transliteration: sarāmam api tāvan me ratham dṛṣṭvā tadā janaḥ ।vinā rāmam ratham dṛṣṭvā vidīryeta api sā purī ॥2-52-40॥

translations.english: The people who had seen Rama board the chariot will be brokenhearted to see it without him.
